title: Store, Actions, and Reducers
description: Learn the three core building blocks of Redux.

data.text: Redux has three core concepts: **Store** (holds state), **Actions** (describe what happened), and **Reducers** (specify how state changes).

data.title: Store
Actions
Reducer
Pure Functions
data.text: Reducers must be pure functions - they should not mutate state, perform side effects, or call non-pure functions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Store, actions, and reducers are the foundation of Redux.
